interface.request: opcode 7, bank B10 only, query_start bits [26:17], m_count [16:11] in 1..32, kv_len [10:0] in 1..1024, query_start+m_count<=kv_len, all other payload bits zero
interface.response: held done_valid/done_ready, tag B10, bank_count=1, B10 release and error
interface.layout: B10 [m_count,9,ceil(kv_len/8)] words, eight BF16 lanes per word; padded and future key lanes store zero probabilities
interface.completion_order: after last in-place B10 write handshake

architecture.algorithm: three passes per row/head: finite valid-score maximum, interpolated exponential sum, reread and in-place probability write
architecture.mask: key index <= query_start+row; arbitrary padding masks and custom position IDs unsupported
architecture.in_place_safety: each output word is read before its own write; no earlier score is required after the third pass reaches it

numeric.score: BF16 finite valid lanes converted to signed Q16.16 with round-to-nearest-even and saturation
numeric.exponential: exp(-x) lookup over [0,24) with 1/32 spacing in unsigned Q0.30, linear interpolation rounded to nearest; x>=24 returns zero
numeric.normalization: 41-bit Q0.30 sum, restoring 2^60/sum integer reciprocal, Q0.30 probability and BF16 round-to-nearest-even
numeric.reference: first-layer SmolLM2-135M checkpoint revision 93efa2f097d58c2a74874c7e644dbc9b0cee75a2, FP32 stable causal softmax followed by BF16 cast
numeric.observed_error: standalone RTL prefill32 9216/9216, decode1 360/360 including padding, and synthetic context1024 9216/9216 all within 2 BF16 ULP; maximum observed 1 ULP

verification.standalone: XSIM golden and illegal-command cases pass; 150 MHz OOC synthesis WNS +0.781 ns, LUT 1281, BRAM tile 2, DSP 7
verification.integration: cumulative RTL XSIM prefill32 and decode1 pass with GPIO-provided pinned scores; ATTN_SCORE arithmetic remains a probe
